The LH1 has been a very strong performer this season, even at closer ranges, which we didn't fully intend it to be. This change to its damage is aimed at addressing that and also bringing it more in line with other weapons' performance.
Increased damage falloff max range from 15m to 17.5m, giving the weapon a slightly longer effective range
Decreased damage falloff multiplier from 0.62 to 0.52, meaning the weapon now does slightly less damage at range. Recorded as a retained-damage percentage to match the sheets' column.

The M11 has been outperforming a number of longer ranged weapons, which was not intended. This small adjustment should make it slightly less effective at longer ranges, but increase the 'effective range' slightly.
Increased damage from 19 to 20
Increased damage falloff max range from 32m to 35m, giving the weapon a slightly longer effective range
Increased damage falloff multiplier from 0.4 to 0.5, meaning the weapon now does slightly more damage at range. Recorded as a retained-damage percentage to match the sheets' column.
Compared to the Lewis Gun and ShAK-50, the M60 has been underperforming. These buffs aim to hopefully bring it closer to those weapons in its effectiveness.
Decreased damage falloff minimum range from 50m to 45m, giving the weapon a slightly shorter effective range
Decreased damage falloff max range from 55m to 50m, giving the weapon a slightly shorter effective range
Decreased damage falloff multiplier from 0.85 to 0.75, meaning the weapon now does slightly less damage at range. Recorded as a retained-damage percentage to match the sheets' column.
Significantly reduced the amount of visual recoil experienced when aiming-down-sights, causing the bullets to land closer to where your reticle indicates
